annotations.pd_harm_distress: My stomach would be in knots just picturing someone getting hit
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd carry that man's injury as mine
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go find his family, tell them exactly what I did and why

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't want to be the one choosing
annotations.pd_harm_distress: thought of anyone crushed out there makes my chest go tight
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sick with regret over whoever got hurt
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go straight to the station staff and the families, describe every detail

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Pulling that lever means I personally aim a train at somebody
annotations.pda_harm_regret: the five getting hurt would haunt me
annotations.pda_responsibility: standing still is still a choice
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help each of those families practically, meals, errands, paperwork

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd hate having to answer it
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Seeing people in danger makes me feel dizzy and awful
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sorry for the rest of my life about that one worker
annotations.pda_repair_intention: visit him or his family, own it plainly, and help cover

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Just imagining somebody hurt turns my insides over
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret what happened to that single person deeply
annotations.pda_repair_intention: sit with his people, explain myself honestly, and press the railway

annotations.pd_harm_distress: My heart would be pounding and I'd feel like throwing up
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd grieve the harm I caused him
annotations.pda_repair_intention: meet his family face to face, answer every question

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Watching people in danger just floods me with dread
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd feel that my stillness helped cause it, and I'd regret it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to each family, tell them honestly I hesitated

annotations.pd_harm_distress: idea of bodies on those tracks makes my hands go cold
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret hurting that man for good
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to him or his family, tell them exactly what happened

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: tense with worry for those workers
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My whole body would be tense with worry for those workers
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret whoever got hurt by what I did
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell investigators everything I saw, then help the injured person's family

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Seeing anyone in harm's way leaves me shaky and upset
annotations.pda_harm_regret: the harm to that one worker would sit heavy on me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: apologize to him or his loved ones in person, explain my reasoning
